note: 可复用的提示词骨架。生成同系列素材时固定 --seed，只改 variables 里的一处，便于保持风格一致。

patterns.name: product-mockup
patterns.use_when: 需要一个干净背景上的产品/界面示意，用作文档或落地页配图
patterns.template: {subject} centered on a seamless {background_color} background, {material} finish, soft studio lighting from upper left, subtle contact shadow, shallow depth of field, no text, no watermark, product photography, 50mm lens

variables.subject: 例如 matte black wireless earbuds case

patterns.negative_hints: 不要让它渲染标签文字，容易出现拼写错误

patterns.name: poster-layout
patterns.use_when: 需要留白给后期排版的背景海报，文字由代码或设计工具叠加
patterns.template: minimal editorial poster background, {palette} palette, large negative space in the {empty_region}, abstract {motif} shape, flat vector grain texture, high contrast, no lettering, print-ready composition

variables.palette: 例如 warm sand and deep teal

patterns.negative_hints: 明确 no lettering，避免模型自己排版出乱码字

patterns.name: app-icon
patterns.use_when: 需要方形图标素材，交给前端或移动端使用时
patterns.template: flat vector app icon of a {object}, {style} style, thick rounded strokes, centered composition, generous padding inside a square canvas, solid {background} background, no text, crisp edges, svg-like cleanliness

variables.object: 例如 compass 或 paper plane

patterns.negative_hints: 方形画布 + 四周留白，避免导出后被裁切

patterns.name: character-sheet
patterns.use_when: 同一角色的多张图要保持一致外观
patterns.template: character reference sheet of {character}, front view and three-quarter view side by side, consistent proportions and outfit across both views, neutral {background} background, even lighting, full body, no text

variables.character: 例如 a courier with a canvas satchel

patterns.negative_hints: 固定 --seed；只改 character 描述，其余部分保持不变

patterns.name: texture-seamless
patterns.use_when: 需要可平铺的材质贴图
patterns.template: seamless tileable {material} texture, top-down orthographic view, even diffuse lighting, no shadows at edges, high detail, repeating pattern, no text

variables.material: 例如 brushed brass 或 recycled paper

patterns.negative_hints: 生成后需目视检查左右/上下边缘是否接得上；模型对 seamless 承诺并不可靠

patterns.name: concept-landscape
patterns.use_when: 概念图、氛围图或占位背景
patterns.template: {scene}, {time_of_day}, {weather}, cinematic wide shot, {palette} color grade, volumetric light, atmospheric depth, matte painting style

variables.scene: 例如 a cliffside observatory above a cloud sea
variables.palette: 例如 cool cyan with warm window light

patterns.negative_hints: 宽幅时用 --width 1536 --height 864 之类的比例

verification_checklist: 文件存在且字节数合理（几十 KB 以上，不是 0 或几百字节的错误页）
JSON 里的 format / width / height 与预期一致
需要文字准确时，确认图上没有乱码字；有就重做或改用叠加排版
同系列素材固定 seed 后风格是否一致
不要把'生成成功'当成'符合需求'：符合需求需要人或其他模型看图确认
